summary: Verified all 3 items and regression. (1) robots.txt: 'Allow: /api/public/' and 'Allow: /api/status/' both appear ABOVE 'Disallow: /api/'; all 4 public content endpoints return 200 unauthenticated. (2) Tx details modal for tx 1060 (USDT-TRC20, $18.84) shows the new fee breakdown: tx-fee-platform='Platform fee $0.19', tx-fee-fixed='Fixed fee $0.94', tx-fee-total='Fee $1.13', Amount Received=$17.71; tx-fee-network is correctly ABSENT (network fee = 0). Sub-fees sum to total (0.19+0.94=1.13) and net matches ($18.84-$1.13=$17.71). (3) Invoice search FE+BE working: baseline 9; 'hostbay' -> 8 rows all customer_name=hostbay; 'INV-20260712' -> 4 rows all invoice_number prefix matches; 'zzznomatch' -> 0 with data-testid=invoices-search-empty-table shown; clearing restores 9. Header Receipts (N) updates correctly. Debounce ~350ms, server-side search confirmed via /api/invoices?search=. Regression: /transactions, /invoices, /brands render with no page errors and no horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844. 'Export settled only' relabel intact (data-testid=transactions-export-settled-only visible).

issues: Total-fees row label reads just 'Fee' rather than 'Total fees' as described in the spec — data-testid=tx-fee-total is present and value is correct, purely a copy nit
